summary: Static code review only (per hard constraint — no build/run/install). Traced all 8 requested checks across RelayPage.jsx/css, electron/{main,preload,social}.js, server/{db/social,db/schema,server}.js, useSocial.js, useRelayGroups.js, BrowseView.jsx/css, UpdateCenter.jsx/css and AccountSwitcherModal.jsx/css. All four P0 fixes are implemented correctly and the earlier Relay regression items (DM reply persistence, replyTo passthrough, edit/delete, group:read, retryMessage) are all wired end-to-end. Two minor cosmetic defects found in AccountSwitcherModal.

ui_bugs.issue: className 'account-login-title' (line 310) has no rule anywhere in the codebase — the login screen H1 will render with only browser-default h1 styling.
className 'account-login-social-btn' (line 423) has no rule anywhere in the codebase — the social/Microsoft button will render as an unstyled <button>.

Modifier classes 'relay-emoji-popover' and 'relay-gif-popover' are applied alongside '.relay-quick-popover' but never targeted by CSS. Not broken (base class still styles them), but the modifiers are dead code and should either get variant rules or be removed.

integration_issues.flow: Global unread badge vs optimistic mute
integration_issues.issue: useSocial.js line 736-739 computes unreadTotal from friend.muted (server truth) instead of the local mutedIds override used by RelayPage. When the user mutes a thread the toggle updates instantly but the app-nav unread badge will still count that thread's unread messages until the server round-trip lands and loadFriends() re-runs. Cosmetic only, does not revert the mute.

action_items: AccountSwitcherModal.css: add rules for .account-login-title and .account-login-social-btn (or remove the classes from the JSX if they're intentionally unstyled).
Optional cleanup: either style .relay-emoji-popover / .relay-gif-popover or drop the modifier classes from RelayPage.jsx.
Optional: in useSocial.js unreadTotal, honor the localStorage mutedIds override (or hoist muted to a shared source) so the app-nav unread badge matches Relay's mute UI immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: P0 #1 formatLastSeen (RelayPage.jsx L63-76): correct — today/yesterday branches, 'DD MMM' for older, 'Offline' fallback for null/NaN. getPresence (L373-397) still returns 'In-game: <serverAddress>' and 'In Launcher' for online/in-game and only falls through to entity.lastSeen (the formatted string) for offline. PASS.

P0 #2 mute persistence: mutedIds is loaded from localStorage in useMemo (L121, L129), persisted on every change (L163-167), applied in mergedFriends via '(mutedIds[friend.id] ?? Boolean(friend.muted))' (L217) and in formattedGroups (L268). handleToggleMute (L544-557) sets state SYNCHRONOUSLY before firing the network call and does NOT await, so a subsequent social.friends refresh can never revert the toggle. PASS.

P0 #3 notifications: electron/main.js registers ipcMain.handle('app:showNotification', ...) with silent:true and click-to-focus (L113-132). preload.js exposes window.native.showNotification(title, body) using the SAME channel 'app:showNotification' (L12). RelayPage.jsx's second social.subscribe effect (L336-369) skips self messages (senderId===selfId), skips muted via '(state.mutedIds[threadId] ?? friend?.muted)', skips system group messages, suppresses when 'document.hasFocus() && activeId===threadId', then plays 587.33Hz→880Hz chime (L79-97) and calls window.native.showNotification. Channel names match end-to-end. PASS.

P0 #4 no gradients in RelayPage.css: grep found zero 'linear-gradient'/'radial-gradient'. No '.relay-inbox::before' selector exists. '.relay-chat-main' (L376-383) is 'background: var(--page)' with no ::before. PASS.

BrowseView dep flow (L311-353): guarded by (queue.length > 0 && guard < 40) and a 'seen' Set keyed on project_id, so a cyclic Modrinth graph cannot loop. Required deps push their own dependencies back onto the queue (recursive walk); optional deps are added to the flat 'optional' list without recursion — matches spec. DependencyPrompt is rendered in BOTH the list view (L631) and the detail view (L1084). confirmDepPrompt (L492-501) concatenates required + user-selected optional and passes them to installBundle, which installs extras BEFORE the main file (L360-396). PASS.

UpdateCenter.jsx: zero lucide/other icon imports (grep returned 0). Renders 'v{currentVersion} → v{status.version}' block when type is 'available' or 'downloaded' (L47-53). Every status.type (disabled/checking/not-available/available/preparing/downloading/downloaded/installing/error/idle) maps to both a headline (L158-171) and subline (L173-186) plus the correct footer buttons (L102-150). PASS.

Relay regression pack (server/db/social.js): MESSAGE_SELECT LEFT JOINs messages parent + users parentAuthor for reply metadata (L354-356). mapMessageRow builds reply object honoring parent.deleted_at (L295-305) and blanks tombstoned rows (L309-319). sendMessage validates that the replyTo parent shares the same DM pair (L455-461) before inserting. server.js POST /v1/social/messages/:friendId forwards replyTo (L689). electron/social.js social:sendMessage forwards replyTo (L352-355) and social:updateFriend forwards pinned+muted (L387-390). useSocial editMessage/deleteMessage call applyMessageUpdate on success (L547-563), and handleEvent maps 'message:updated' to applyMessageUpdate (L307-309). useRelayGroups group:read case (L222-236) zeros own unread and stores others in readByGroup, exposing activeReadAt (L462-465). retryMessage exists (L525). PASS.
AccountSwitcherModal: grep for showAccounts / account-login-existing / account-login-sec-btn returned zero hits — the deleted state and CSS classes are fully purged from both the .jsx and the .css.

Minor: useSocial's notification effect and the relayGroups.handleSocialEvent effect both list `[social]` / `[social, relayGroups]` — since useSocial returns a new object on every render this re-subscribes each render. The Set-based subscribe/unsubscribe cleans up correctly so it's not a leak, just wasteful. Not blocking.
Minor: playPingChime creates a fresh AudioContext for every ping and closes it in osc.onended. Fine functionally; consider a single lazy singleton if ping frequency ever grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repo is an Electron desktop app with NO node_modules and NO running services — do not attempt yarn/npm install, supervisor, curl localhost or Playwright. Only static file review is possible. The four P0 batch items (last-seen formatter, mute persistence in native_relay_store_v5.mutedIds, IPC 'app:showNotification' + Web Audio chime, and gradient removal from RelayPage.css) are all correctly implemented. The Modrinth dependency prompt in BrowseView.jsx is fully wired with a 40-iteration guard and seen-set — no infinite loop risk. Only outstanding items are two undefined CSS classes in AccountSwitcherModal.jsx (account-login-title, account-login-social-btn) and a purely cosmetic mismatch between the optimistic mute in RelayPage and the server-driven unreadTotal in useSocial.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no reproducible bug; two minor CSS omissions are listed under frontend_issues.ui_bugs with exact selectors and line numbers.
